rows.what_the_ink_shows: The coefficient calculation ends with an uncancelled minus in front of the sigma/(beta rho) fraction and a bracket containing 2 sigma prime + rho. Thus the source accurately records the targeted minus-outside, plus-inside expression. Both rows refer to this same location.
